what_happened: Scene L8: large grey sponge_5 on a wood counter, dark cutting_board_4 ~45 cm to the left near the sink. Stage 0 normal: grasp 95 (width 0.067, wide sponge), lifted 10 cm, carried left; stage 0 from 97. Stage 1: first board contact 198 (counter 1). 196-300 the sponge was rubbed on the board (wrist view: board under the sponge), but from 202 to 345 finger_joint1 sat at its open limit (q1 0.039-0.041, q2 -0.024) so OU.check_obj_grasped was False and none of these contacts counted; the sponge also rotated in the grip (tilt 8 -> 30 deg). 300-345 it drifted off the board's right edge over the counter, 346/354 two contacts counted (2, 3) as the fingers re-centred, then it lifted the sponge to +15 cm (394-402), came back over the board, pressed at 444-452 (counter 4 at 450) and opened at 456, leaving the sponge on the board's right part; eef > 15 cm at 475. Final 4 contacts, sweep 0.258. 480-800: arm raised, robot looked around at the wall/cabinets, no further attempt.
causal_chain: short real scrub 196-300 counted as only 1 point because the grasp test was False (finger-1 at open limit) 202-345 -> sponge drifted off the board 300-400 -> one more press 444-452 -> released at 456 with 4/5 contacts -> wandered to timeout
self_recovery: Partial: after drifting off the board it lifted, returned and pressed once more (450, +1 contact) before releasing. Never re-grasped after the release.
official_criterion_notes: The env counts a board contact only if OU.check_obj_grasped is True; that test reduces to finger_joint1 < 0.035 (finger_joint2 is negative, so its '< 0.035' test always passes). Here the sponge was firmly held (touch, sum width 0.065) but finger 1 sat at 0.039-0.041 for 202-345, so the main scrub went uncounted. Sponge_5 is wide (q1 ~0.032 at a centred grasp), 3 mm from the threshold.

packet_facts: trace grasp False 202-345 while touch True; states q1 0.039-0.041 q2 -0.024..-0.026

uncertain_about: How many extra points the blind window would have given: I cannot check sponge-board contact without the sim. The sponge was visibly on the board during 196-300, but its movement there was modest (a few cm), so maybe 1-3 points.
